name: DEV Roundabouts Showcase
summary: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. BUILDS Better Roundabouts combinations on game load by default.
description: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Never publish this mod. Its defaults BUILD hundreds of constructions 5 s after a game loads: only enable it on a throwaway Blank Slate map. Developer tool for square_roundabouts: on game load (when Run is On) it enumerates Better Roundabouts param combinations, lays them out across the map in a pattern (grid, mosaic, kaleidoscope, mandala, spiral, gradient, checkerboard, scatter), logs the plan and an ASCII preview as [SQRB-SHOW] lines to stdout.txt and, in Build mode, builds every combination the engine accepts. See plans/square_roundabouts_showcase/PLAN.md.
